---
name: Semantic or profile proposal
about: Propose a definition, distinction, profile, or evidence-grounded learning change
title: "[Proposal] "
---

## Problem and scope

Who needs this? Which requirement and roadmap IDs apply? Is this a local profile or shared meaning?

## Evidence and examples

Provide publication-cleared source references or synthetic text, expected and observed behavior, one positive example, and one counterexample. State what remains uncertain.

## Proposed change and alternatives

Define the term/rule and its boundaries. Why is an existing concept or local adapter insufficient?

## Compatibility, evaluation, and impact

List affected versions, label changes, regression/unseen evaluation plan, migration scope, cost, and rollback. Separate a hypothesis from an adjudicated requirement.

## Review and assistance

Identify required expertise and any model/tool assistance. Do not imply approval or source verification that has not occurred.
